title: each item must have an id and at least one content field

spec.name: JSON Feed
spec.normative_quote: id (required, string) is unique for that item for that feed over time... content_html and content_text are each optional strings — but one or both must be present.
spec.note: Verified against a live fetch of https://www.jsonfeed.org/version/1.1/ on 2026-07-30. Corrects a prior defect: the content clause was reworded ('each optional, but at least one is required') from the spec's actual wording ('each optional strings -- but one or both must be present'). The id clause was already accurate and is unchanged.

applicability: An entry in a parsed feed.json document's "items" array.
expectation: The item has an "id", and at least one of "content_html" / "content_text".

cases.name: an item with neither content_html nor content_text
